title: 土質力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Soil Mechanics I
keywords: Basic properties and classification method of soil 2.Consistency limits of clayey soil 3.Incremental stress distribution in elastic ground 4.Consolidation theory 5.Permiability of soil (Darcy's law)
educationalGoal: This course aims to provide a basic knowledge of soil propeties and the relationship between soil and water, and understanding of estimation method of consolidation.
advice: This course will impart a solid grounding in Soil Mechanics. The contents are shown as followings. 1.Introduction Relationship with Soil Mechanics, GeoTechnical Engineering and geo-disaster prevention. 2.Basic properties of soil Engineering definition of soil, Differences of sand and clay, Density of soil and void ratio water content of soil 3.Classification of soil Necesity of determination and classification of soil material Consistency limits of soil, Engineering classification of soil maerial 4. Incremental stress distribution in elastic ground Calculation method of incremental stress in ground for consolidation estimation 5. Consolidation Percolation and Darcy's law, Consolidation theory by Terzaghi Estimation of consolidation settlement Preconsolidation pressure, Secondary consolidation, Accelerated consolidation method
books: Soil mechanics, 8th Edition, by F. Kawakami, Morikita inc.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of basis of Mechanics. Reading textbook in advance is available to easy understanding.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand basic soil mechanics and know importance in civiengineering field.[0.1K]
Be able to understand physical properties and structure of soil, and calculate state quantitity.[0.3K]
Be able to calculate the incremental stress in ground due to structure load. [0.1K]
Beable to understand the effective stress and one dimensional consolidation theory of Terzaghi.[0.3K]
Be able to calculation of settlement under sevaral conditions.[0.1K]

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully understand the behavioral goals of Soil Mechanics I, and acquire basic skills as an engineer. (2) Explain and discuss the relationship between physical test results and consolidation test results. (3) Calculate consolidation settlement under several conditions on actual construction including step loading.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the behavioral goals of Soil Mechanics I, the basic properies of soil by from physical soil tests as an engineer. (2) Calculate consolidation settlement for basic design.

lessons.content: Engineering properties of soil. Grain size distribution.
Density and voild of soil, and its engineering necessity.
The relationship between physical properties and mechanical properties of soil
lessons.operation: Lecture and practice Self-reflection and Q&A

lessons.content: Overview of consolidation and percolation phenomena
